abilities.name: Favonius Bladework - Maid
_curatorNotes: Charged attack uses a parametric spinning mechanic (claymore spin + finisher). chargeFrames here are for the minimum case: single spin + finisher from standing (windup=56f). ActionDash/Jump/Swap are explicitly set to 0 in gcsim's chargeFrames and resolved to the spin hitmark (frame 23) via a custom Frames closure — effective cancel = windup(56)+23 = 79. N/E/Q values include spinFrames(23)+transFrames(13) added to the base table values. Windup is state-dependent: 56 from standing, 45 after N3, 44 after dash, 41 after another CA, 47 after plunge. Additional spins increase all N/E/Q values by 23f per extra spin. Reviewer to decide final representation.

High plunge exists in gcsim (highPlungeFrames: hitmark=42, swap=64, N=53, E=52, Q=52, D=42); not represented here per recipe. Low plunge (hitmark=39) used for plungeFrames. ActionJump not explicitly set in lowPlungeFrames (defaults to AnimationLength=80) — omitted per InitAbilSlice rule.

abilities.name: Breastplate
abilities.caveat: While Stone Armor is up, Noelle's Normal and Charged Attack hits have a ~59% chance to heal the whole party (rising to 100% at C1 while her Elemental Burst is active). The planner shows the heal on every qualifying hit — the actual proc chance is not simulated.
_curatorNotes: Shield + heal effects authored 2026-07-12 at talent level 10 (gcsim skill.go + noelle_gen.go index 9; sidecar 'DMG Absorption' / 'Healing' / 'Healing Triggering Chance' rows, col 10).

Shield (Stone Armor): scaling 288% DEF + 1693.66 flat (gcsim shieldDef[9]=2.88, shieldFlat[9]=1693.6555; sidecar '288% DEF+1694'). Target 'active' — gcsim adds a player shield (newShield → Shields.Add, Target -1) protecting the on-field character, same convention as the Devotion passive shield. Authored deliberately WITHOUT a `duration` field: the 12s window is already owned by the summons[] Stone Armor entry, and registerShieldOnCast (notationParser) registers a window from BOTH Case-1 (summon-tagged shield) AND Case-2 (Effect.type 'shield' with onCast + duration). Adding a duration here would register two identical 12s windows and double-fire C4's onShieldEnd Geo explosion — omitting it keeps the summon as the single onShieldEnd source. 150% all-element/physical absorption efficiency not modelled.

Heal: 38.3% DEF + 226 flat per proc to ALL party members (gcsim skillHealCB: shieldHeal[9]=0.38304, shieldHealFlat[9]=225.99677, snapshotted Healing bonus; HealInfo Target -1 = whole team → target 'team'; sidecar '38.3% DEF+226'). Two onHit effects (abilityType normal + charged, source self) mirror the kit text 'Normal and Charged Attacks'. gcsim also attaches skillHealCB to the initial E cast hit and the two burst-cast hits (NOT plunge — plunge.go has no callback); those implementation-detail procs are not authored as separate effects. Requires the Stone Armor shield to be up (gcsim gates on Shields.Get(NoelleSkill) != nil). No explicit condition authored, mirroring the Thoma Crimson Ooyoroi onHit precedent (host-ability window scoping); a 'duringSummon' condition would NOT resolve here since inferredStates only detects stationary persistent summons and Stone Armor is a follows-mobility instant-skill summon. The ~59% proc chance (healChance[9]=0.59; raised to 100% at C1 while the burst buff is active, per skill.go/cons.go prob branch) is surfaced in the caveat — no probability primitive in the schema.

Retained: Stone Armor modeled as summons[] (12s, follows, recast); C4 explosion authored on the constellation node via onShieldEnd source:self ability:skill, firing at the summon's scheduled expiry. gcsim re-adding a new shield overwrites the old one via the OnOverwrite hook (also explodes at C4).
abilities.description:
Summons protective stone armor, dealing Geo DMG to surrounding opponents and creating a shield. The shield's DMG Absorption scales based on Noelle's DEF.
The shield has the following properties:
·When Noelle's Normal and Charged Attacks hit a target, they have a certain chance to regenerate HP for all characters.
·Possesses 150% DMG Absorption efficiency against all Elemental and Physical DMG.

The amount of HP healed when regeneration is triggered scales based on Noelle's DEF.

abilities.name: Sweeping Time
_curatorNotes: Burst creates a ~16.3s (980f = 900 + burstStart=80) duration self-buff: DEF-to-ATK conversion at talent-level multiplier + geo infusion on N/Plunge/CA. C6 extends duration by up to +10s (1s per kill, max 10 kills; gcsim parameter 'extend'). Not modeled as a summon — no spawned entity; duration belongs on self-buff representation. generator's 'duration: 15' was incorrect (confused with CD) and has been removed.
Burst has two activation hits in gcsim: 'Sweeping Time (Burst)' at frame 24 (r=6.5) and 'Sweeping Time (Skill)' at frame 65 (r=4). Not represented in a hits[] array per recipe.
Normals/plunge/charge are geo-infused during burst window via Snapshot override (cannot be overridden by other infusions). The 'infusion' field on this ability may need authoring by reviewer.
abilities.description:
Gathering the strength of stone around her weapon, Noelle strikes the opponents surrounding her within a large AoE, dealing Geo DMG.
Afterwards, Noelle gains the following effects:
·Larger attack AoE.
·Converts attack DMG to Geo DMG that cannot be overridden by any other elemental infusion.
·Increased ATK that scales based on her DEF.

passives.name: Devotion
_curatorNotes: 2026-05-09 model-mismatch cleanup: rewrote from `damage def 400 target:enemy` to `shield active def 400 duration:20`. The 150% all-element/physical absorption efficiency is not modelled.

2026-05-11 (E2 follow-up + recipientHpBelow ship): trigger migrated from `manual` to `passive` once the `recipientHpBelow` primitive landed. Conditions: Noelle ascension≥4 + off-field + recipient (active char) HP<30%. The `recipientHpBelow` resolves to null at planner-time (same optimistic-fire treatment as enemyHpBelow / selfHpBelow), so the shield renders with the standard 'assumed to hold' caveat. The 60s ICD is not modelled. The 150% all-element/physical absorption efficiency is not modelled.
passives.description:
When Noelle is in the party but not on the field, this ability triggers automatically when your active character's HP falls below 30%:
Creates a shield for your active character that lasts for 20s and absorbs DMG equal to 400% of Noelle's DEF.
The shield has a 150% DMG Absorption effectiveness against all Elemental and Physical DMG.
This effect can only occur once every 60s.

_curatorNotes: 2026-05-14 (onShieldEnd primitive): trigger migrated from `manual` to `onShieldEnd source:self ability:skill`. Fires at Breastplate's scheduled expiry (Stone Armor summon, 12s). Shatter-by-damage (OnDamage hook, HP reaches 0) and overwrite-by-recast (OnOverwrite) are NOT simulated — the planner has no enemy/HP state, so the trigger fires at scheduled expiry only following the standard null-resolving 'assumed to hold' convention. Damage effect emits via the `shieldEndEvents` stream on ParsedRotation; per-event rendering is a future renderer pass.

constellations.name: Must Be Spotless
_curatorNotes: 2026-05-11 (queue item 4): authored via existing-schema DEF→ATK pattern. `stat: 'atk', value: { type: 'scaling', stat: 'def', ratio: 50 }` expresses '+50% of DEF as flat ATK'. Trigger=onCast burst with duration 16.3 (matches the burst's ~980f self-buff window per the burst curator note: 980f = 900 + burstStart=80, ÷60 ≈ 16.3s). The C6's +1s/kill duration extension (up to +10s) is not modelable — gcsim parameter 'extend' tracks kills which the planner doesn't simulate.

Base Sweeping Time DEF-to-ATK conversion (at talent-level multiplier, ~80% at TL10) remains UNAUTHORED — separate from this C6 +50% addition. Once the base burst self-buff is authored, this C6 entry stacks on top per the in-game text 'an additional 50% of her DEF'.
constellations.description:
Sweeping Time increases Noelle's ATK by an additional 50% of her DEF.
Additionally, every opponent defeated during the skill's duration adds 1s to the duration, up to 10s.
